true_answer: Understanding converses and contrapositives can help understand implications and their truth values: Example 0.2.6 Suppose I tell Sue that if she gets a 93% on her final, then she will get an A in the class. Assuming that what I said is true, what can you conclude in the following cases: 1. Sue gets a 93% on her final. 2. Sue gets an A in the class. 3. Sue does not get a 93% on her final. 4. Sue does not get an A in the class. Solution . Note first that whenever P → Q and P are both true statements, Q must be true as well.
